svg.title: Reciprocal translocation
svg.desc: ABCDE, centromere, FGH and MNOPQ, centromere, R exchange terminal AB and MNO. Products: MNOCDE, centromere, FGH and ABPQ, centromere, R. Color follows segment identity; red arrows mark B/C and O/P cuts; white zigzags mark joins, distinct from pale centromere collars. Single chromatids; spacing and decorative bands are schematic.
